steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Huff, puff... The exit is right ahead. I've made it out... With so many monsters, they won't be able to catch up...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Thanks to <color=#fb9259>this</color>... Monsters and Corruptors won't attack me... Haha... but darn it! I still can't find the suspect. What am I gonna say to them?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: They'll kill me... <color=#fb9259>They</color>'ll definitely kill me. It's all because of that bitch. Why didn't she listen to my orders? How dare she betray me... I should've killed that dog earlier!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I must find that Sinner... Or will I be fine if I kill the people in SALVA? What if I show them the corpse of the Chief?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Yes! That will work! They hate MBCC. They won't kill me...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content:
I'll get out of here first and find a bunch of thugs tonight. I still have the Mania Crystal. I can still fight...
I've made it out!!!

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Hello again, Ted.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...How did you get here? How are you still alive?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The artificial eye I gave you, does it help?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Stop your crap... It's all thanks to you that I won't be able to touch crystals for the rest of my life.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: But that won't cure you, right?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You stirred up your men and enslaved Sinners. Now you're destroying my hospital for that so-called inheritance... I finally get it now. You'll never give up on Mania.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...You want to kill me?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You're a doctor, have you ever killed anyone? Stop pretending. Do you actually dare?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...Doctors don't kill. I only heal.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ted!! Show yourself!!!

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You're too slow...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's going on?!
She frees her grip on Ted's collar. The man quietly kneels in front of the doctor with a gentle smile on his face.

Iron stands right in the center of the battlefield. But this battlefield has no casualties. All her enemies around her are on their knees without any pain and resentment on their faces. They are all alive yet as good as dead.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Emergency neuromodulation completed. Violent impulses and mobility completely removed. Postoperative treatment completed.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Operation successful. Ted, you're cured.
